ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity; estimated ratio of approximately 1:18 high-intensity (white/glare) to low-intensity (dark pigmentation) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black) distribution across 95% of the visible surface area; high-intensity pixel clusters are restricted to the extreme distal tips and specular reflections from water.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with a frequency of approximately 12-15 detectable peaks per lobe and a pixel-amplitude variation of 3-10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to the median notch; outer distal lobes exhibit a sharp convex turn.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged asymmetry and pixel-level fragmentation at the distal lobe tips, especially the left-most edge.
